Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game then! India not only won the T20I series but also the ODI series. The spoils were shared in the Test series. Overall, it has been a tour to remember for the Indians who will now head to Windies. England on the other hand, will be playing an ODI series against South Africa. We hope you enjoyed our company. Until next time, goodbye!
Rohit Sharma is joined by his team-mates to lift the trophy. A good gesture by the skipper, as it is Arshdeep Singh who lifts the trophy. The Indian celebrations have began.

Rohit Sharma, the victorious skipper, is in for a chat. He says that he is very pleased with his side. They aimed to achieve something in white-ball cricket and is really happy about the same. Further adds, he remembers they lost here last time but finally to come and achieve an ODI series win is a commendable effort from the side. Says Pant and Pandya played clinical shots and that did the work for them. Praises Chahal for making a strong comeback in the shortest format after being left out of the T20 World Cup last time around. Adds he always backs the lads because all of them are experienced. Further says, he is very lucky to have the depth at his disposal. The number of games played these days it is a necessity to keep your bench strong.

Jos Buttler, the captain of England says they were short but their bowlers started excellently. Adds he is not concerned about the result, the side has not batted well in longer formats and that's what they will focus on. Mentions Topley has been great throughout the series and is really happy with his growth. Says whenever you give a second chance to a great player it will surely be an expensive mistake. Mentions, Adil Rashid will be very crucial ahead of the West Indies series.

HARDIK PANDYA, WINS THE PLAYER OF THE SERIES AWARD, for his consistentcy throughout the white-ball series. He starts by saying white-ball cricket has a special place in his heart and is glad to excel in this series. Adds it was very important for him to stop the run flow. They were cruising at one point, and it was important to control the game. Adds he likes to bowl the short ones and is happy to take on the challenges throughout. Says he is shameless as a bowler, adds he does not care how much he goes for. Ends by praising the effort of Pant with the blade.

Rishabh Pant WINS THE PLAYER OF THE MATCH AWARD for his maiden ODI ton, who also led his side over the victory line. He starts by saying hopefully he is remembered at Old Trafford for a long time. Says he focused on taking it one ball at a time. Mentions it is always a great feeling to get your side out of trouble. Further adds he focuses on playing as much cricket as he can and gain a lot of experience. Mentions, the bowlers were on the money through the series and hopefully, they remain the same throughout the year.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the day, after being inserted, England put up an average score of 259 on the board! They failed to put up significant partnerships, there were a few batters who got off to starts but none made it big. The hosts also failed to bat out their 50 overs. They began well with the ball but a stunning partnership between Pant and Pandya took the game away.

For England, Topley was absolutely brilliant yet again! He bagged three at the start but for the rest, it was a struggle to take wickets. Also, the sudden change of plan of bowling short was quite surprising by England. The missed chances in the field also did not help their cause. Pant's stumping chance went abegging and then Pandya could have been caught at fine leg. Have to say, it was India who were more hungry for a win and it is them who came out on top.

This innings was only about two men and one partnership! India were reeling at 72 for 4 and were in deep trouble. Pant and Pandya though joined association and played in an attacking manner. The two kept the score board ticking along which never let the pressure build on the two. Pandya was the aggressor and Pant was happy to play second fiddle. The duo added over 100 before Pandya fell. India till then were well and truly on top. Pant then stepped on the gas, Jadeja played as the perfect foil to him. Rishabh got his ton up and the two ensured there were no more wickets to fall and SEALED THE SERIES FOR INDIA!

What a chase! What an amazing chase this was! Take a bow Rishabh Pant! He has played an innings of a lifetime. Absolutely stunning. Walked out when India had lost two early wickets but stayed there till the end. Credit to Pandya too who also batted brilliantly. He too would have loved to have scored a ton but he along with Pant has helped India win a game from a position not many thought they would.

FOUR! Rishabh Pant comes out with a reverse-sweep to finish things off. He removes his helmet and shows a thumbs up to the crowd. He has a smile across his face and why wouldn't he? All of the England players congratulate Pant for his knock. It is tossed up, on off. Pant reverse-sweeps it through backward point for a boundary. INDIA WIN THE GAME BY 5 WICKETS.
Woah! He toys with us now. He does not get 6 boundaries in a row but has surely played an entertaining knock. It is full and on off. Pant flicks it through mid-wicket and crosses for one.
FIVE BOUNDAIES IN A ROW! It is full and on off. Rishabh Pant clears his front leg and drills it down the ground. He gets a boundary at long on. Can he end this in the last ball of the over?
FOUR! Make that four in a row! He is toying with Willey now. Going around the dart board. It is a good length, angled down leg. Rishabh Pant scoops it towards fine leg for a boundary. 8 needed now.

Four, four and four! Three on the trot. Rishabh Pant wants to end things early here. It is full and outside off. Rishabh Pant drives it along the ground through covers for another boundary. 12 more needed now. He can end this in three balls.

FOUR! India need just another 4 boundaries! Short and on middle, Pant pulls again, it goes through square leg and into the fence. 4 balls to go in this over, do not rule out the game ending in this one.
FOUR! FLAT-BATTED! Short and on off, Pant slams it down the ground and to the long off fence. Pant now wants to finish this in a hurry.
Outside off, left alone.

100 for Pant! What a knock! Yes, he has had his luck but take nothing away from the way he has played. Just brilliant. Came out when India were staring down the barrel and now has almost won them the game. It is also his FIRST ODI TON! A special moment for him in an important game. He gets there by playing a well controlled pull shot through square leg for one.

JUST OVER! Pant moves onto 99! It is his day probably. A stumping chance missed and now one that just clears the fielder. On another day, it could have easily gone to hand! Short and on middle, Pant looks to pull, it goes off the splice but just clears the leaping mid on fielder. Two taken.
Shorter and on the body, this is nudged to square leg.
Short again, Jadeja now pulls it down to fine leg and takes one more.
Another short one! Too easy for Pant. He pulls it through square leg for one.
Powerplay 2 comes to an end! Now, 5 players can be placed outside the inner circle until the end of the innings. Craig Overton comes back into the attack to find some inspiration.
Keeps strike! Just a boundary away now and India need below 30. On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
SIX! Smashed! Over the fence! What a hit that is. On middle, Pant gets down on one knee and hammers it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. He is five away from scoring a ton.
Some inward movement but the line was too straight. Jadeja looks to flick but misses, it hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Singles will do it for India! On the pads, this is clipped down to fine leg for one.
Outside off, on a length. Jadeja guides it through point and gets to the other end.
Length and on off, Jadeja defends it onto the ground.
FOUR MORE! India inching closer! The sweep is out, it is played fine on the leg side and it races away to the fence.
On middle, Pant works it to mid-wicket.
Another short one around off, Jadeja pushes it through covers and gets to the other end.
Shorter and outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, Jadeja works it through square leg and gets to the other end.
On the pads, Pant works it towards short fine leg for one.
Shot! On middle, Pant works it wide of the fielder at mid on and gets to the other end.
Back of a length and on off, Pant guides it to point.
Jadeja takes one now! 48 needed! Shorter and outside off, this is guided through point for one.
Back of a length and on off, this is guided to point.
Two again! Shorter and on midde, this is pulled wide of deep mid-wicket for one.
Clears the fielder! Pant steps out and makes room. This is full and outside off, Pant lofts it over mid off. More off the toe-end but clears the fielder for two.
Confusion but safe! On middle, Jadeja works it to mid on and wants one, he takes off but is sent back by Pant.
Around off, Jadeja pushes it to covers.
A single now as this is pushed to mid on.
Another one on the stumps, Pant keeps it out.
On middle, a little bit of turn, defended.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Full, on off, driven through covers for one.
Length ball, outside off. Jadeja looks to chase it but misses.
On off, defended.
Ravindra Jadeja is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! England break this stand but is it a little too late? End of an excellent innings from Pandya! He would have loved to taken his side over the line but he has played an outstanding knock here. A short one and on middle, this one comes slow off the surface. Pandya is early in the pull, it goes off the toe-end towards mid-wicket. Stokes runs in, dives forward and takes a stunner. Something special was needed to break this partnership and it has been provided by Stokes. Will there be a twist? Another quick wicket and England will enter the tail.
Commentary.Howout: c Ben Stokes b Brydon Carse

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Hardik Pandya is in the mood. It is a low full toss, on middle. Hardik Pandya drives it through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Nicely played. It is short and outside off. Pandya gets behind the line and pulls it through square leg for four.

SIX! BANG! Rishabh Pant uses his feet and sends it sailing over the ropes. It is a full-length delivery, on off. Pant dances down the track and smokes it over the long on fence for a maximum. There is great catch in the crowd.
FOUR! Incredible shot. Back of a length, outside off. Rishabh Pant stays back and slashes it through point for a boundary. He wants to end things quickly here.
Good length, outside off. Pandya gets on top of the bounce and punches it through covers. Ben Stokes gives it a chase and stops it in time. The batters take three.
Short ball, on off. Pant pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Full length, outside off. Pant pushes it to mid off. He looks for a single but Hardik Pandya sends him back.
Full length, on off. Pant drives it to the left of mid on. Reece Topley stops it with a dive. No run there.

DRINKS! India are in pole position to win this game and the series! Both Pant and Pandya are looking untroubled and they just need to bat sensibly to get over the line. England on the other hand, need a couple of wickets quickly as that will see them enter into the lower middle-order. Can they find the much-needed breakthrough?
Full length, outside off. Pant reaches out. It goes to third man off the outside edge. They take a single.
Three dots in a row now. Good length, on top of off. Rishabh Pant defends it out watchfully.
Touch fuller, around middle. Pant defends it to cover from inside the crease.
Length ball, around middle and leg. Pant stays behind and blocks it with full face.
Length ball, on off. Pandya pushes it to mid on and crosses for one.

Brydon Carse starts with a short ball, on off. Pandya shuffles across and pulls it to deep square leg. The batters push hard for one, mainly Pandya. The fielder in the deep fumbles, Hardik sees it and calls for the second run. Rishabh Pant though was very late into his charge. The throw from the deep was not on the money which allowed Pant to complete the second run.
Brydon Carse comes back on! England need a wicket and they need a wicket now.

FOUR! It is pulled again and the result is the same. Short ball, on the body. Rishabh Pant swivels on the back foot and pulls it along the ground through square leg for another boundary. The Indian fans at Old Trafford are wide awake now.
FOUR! Into the gap! 100 partnership is brought up in style. It is a short ball, outside off. Pant frees his arms and pulls it through mid-wicket. It races away.
Touch fuller, outside off, angled across. Pant steps across and pushes it gently towards covers.
On off, defended out.
Good length, angled down leg. Rishabh Pant flicks it down to fine leg for a couple of runs. The stand moves to 99.
A dot to start the over! Length ball, on off. Pant defends it back to the bowler on the front foot.
Craig Overton is back!

FOUR! Exceptional timing! Hardik Pandya at his best. It is flatter, outside off. Hardik Pandya stays back and punches it through the gap at covers. The fielder in the deep sprints to his right, puts in a dive but does not get to the ball.
A single now as this is worked through covers.
FOUR! Up and over! A stunning shot from Rishabh Pant. It is full and wide outside off. Rishabh Pant lofts it inside-out over mid off. It goes wide of the long off and gets into the boundary.
Fuller and on off. Pandya drives it through mid off for a single.
Looped up, on off. Pandya defends it on the front foot.
Short ball, outside off. Pandya cuts it hard but straight to the fielder.

FOUR! Fifty for Pant as well. These two batters have kept their side in the game. It is full and on off. Pant steps forward and lofts it over the bowler's head to find a boundary. India need 101 runs more in 114 balls.
Length ball, on the pads, Pandya flicks it down to square leg for a single.
Full length, wide outside off, Pant reaches out and slashes it through point for a single.
It is a short ball, wide outside off. Pant leaves it alone for the keeper.
On a length, around off. Pant blocks it to the off side. Well, due to the stump mic we can hear that Panya is appreciating Pant after every shot even if it is a defensive one.
Stokes starts with a length ball, on the pads, Pandya flicks it to fine leg for a single.
A mix-up but all safe in the end! Shorter and on off, Pant pushes it towards cover and takes off. He is halfway down the wicket but is sent back, in time have to say.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Slightly shorter and on off, Pant pushes it through covers and gets to the other end.
Tossed up on off, Pant leans forward and keeps it out.
Too easy! Shorter and on off, Pandya pushes it through covers for one more.
Another easy single! England have to find a way to stop these singles! On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Change. Liam Livingstone comes into the attack now.
7 from Stokes' first over! Length and around off, this is pushed through covers for one. 112 needed in 126 balls.
Around off, Pant guides it towards point. No run taken.
On the stumps, defended nicely.
On the pads, Pandya works it down to fine leg and takes one.
Shorter again and on off, Pant slaps it through covers for one.
FOUR! That has been hammered! Shorter in length and on middle, Pant smashes it through mid-wicket and this races away to the fence.
A dot to end then! On middle, Pandya plays it back to the bowler.
Another easy single! On off, this is pushed down to long off for a single.
Fires this into the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
Good sensible batting is what India need right now! On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
A quick run! On off, Pandya opens the face of the bat and guides it to point.
Tossed up on off, this is worked to mid-wicket.
A dot to end but the damage was done earlier on! On a length and around middle, defended.
WIDE! Another wide! Topley is not getting it right in this spell. Maybe the heat is getting to him! Short and down the leg side. Left alone.
Now a single! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled nicely through square leg for one.
On off, Pandya pushes it to mid off. A slower one this time.

FOUR! That is a glorious stroke! Pandya is in his elements here. Fuller and on middle, this is thumped down the ground and into the long off fence. England can't stop the scoring here. Just another 125 runs more needed.
WIDE! An appeal to put the umpire off but he signals a wide! Shorter and down the leg side. Pandya looks to pull but misses.
FOUR! Timed wonderfully and Pandya is taking the game away from England. He is onto 40 in no time! Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for a boundary.
Length and on off, Pandya pushes it to covers.
Tidy over to end with from Moeen! Flatter and outside off, Pant shoulders arms to this one. England need more of this now.
Good from Moeen Ali! Flatter and on off, Pant guides it to point.
Fuller and on off, Pant pushes it to covers.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one more.
Flatter and on off, Pandya guides it to point.
On middle, Pandya works it to mid-wicket.
Two more! Another expensive over! Shorter and on middle, Pant hits this through mid-wicket and takes two.
England need dots to build pressure now! Length and on off, it is defended.
On a good length and on off, Pandya guides it down to third man for one.
That has been cracked! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled hard through square leg for a single. The fifty run stand is also up. It has come up in quick time.
Another easy single! Good batting! On off, Pandya pushes it through covers for one.
FOUR! Yet another over which begins with a boundary! England now under pressure here! This is full and on middle, Pandya strokes it down the ground to the long on fence.
Make that three! So despite the boundary, just the 5 from it. On off, Pant pushes it to covers.
Two dots in a row! On off, flatter, this is pushed to cover.
Angled into middle, Pant defends.
Another easy run! On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
FOUR! That is a hit me delivery! It is full and outside off, a half volley with no one behind on the off side. Pandya smashes it through covers.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
On the fuller side again, Pant pushes it to mid on. 149 needed in 162 balls.
Good from Overton! Length again and on off, this is guided down to third man for one.
That is a beauty! This is the length you need to bowl here! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Pandya is beaten as he tries to defend.
Bangs this one short but it is not that well-directed. Pant looks to pull, it goes off the glove down to fine leg for one.
Outside off, this is guided through point for one more. Sensible batting is what is needed now.
Shorter and on middle, Pandya nudges it to mid-wicket.
Another run to end! Shorter and on the body, this is pulled down to fine leg for another single. 17 from the last 2 overs.
Loud appeal but turned down! On the pads, a slower one. Pant goes down on one knee and looks to heave it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads. It rolls on the leg side for one.
Nicely pulled! Short and on middle, Pandya gets on top of the bounce and pulls it through square leg for one.
Goes fuller and on middle, Pandya hits it back towards the bowler who sticks a hand out. It hits it and goes to mid on. A good hand by the bowler.
Angled into middle, Pandya works it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! SHOT! Fuller, fractionally full. Pandya shows the full face of the bat and strokes it through extra cover. Boundaries coming thick and fast now.
Another one on the shorter side, Pandya looks to push at it but it goes off the inner half down to fine leg for another single.
Short and on the body, this is pulled through square leg and a single is taken. 100 up for India. They need another 160 in 175 balls.
Length delivery and on middle, Pant works it to mid-wicket.
Outside off and on a length, Pant leaves it alone.
Drags his length back and bowls it on a length and on off, defended nicely.
FOUR! Runs flowing now in the last few overs! Lovely shot! Fuller and on off, Pant shows the full face of the bat and creams it down the ground and to the long off fence.
FOUR! Second boundary of the over. A good over for India. It is a length ball, down leg. Pandya glances it down to fine leg and finds the boundary.
Full length, on the pads, Pant clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball, on off.Pandya pulls it to fine leg for one.

FOUR! A much-needed boundary for India. A short ball, angled down leg. Hardik Pandya pulls it to fine leg. It clears the man in the deep as Craig Overton misjudges it in the deep. One bounce and into the boundary.
Length ball, around off, angled across. Pant guides it down to third man for one.
Carse goes full, on off. Pant gets on the front foot to block it out.
Short ball, on off. Pandya is early into his pull shot and does not get any run off it.
This one is a bit quicker, length, on off. Pandya stays back to block it out.
Good length, on top of off. Pandya defends it out watchfully.
LEG BYE! Good length, down leg. Pant stays back and tries to flick it away. It goes square on the leg side off his pads. They collect a leg bye.
Fuller now, outside off. Pant drives it down the ground but does not time it well.
Overton serves a short ball, on the body. Pandya stands tall and pulls it through mid-wicket for an easy single.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Fuller, not timed that well, past the bowler for one.
Yet another dot! These dots will build pressure! Shorter and on middle, this one stays low. Pant does well to keep it out.
Angled into middle, this is clipped through square leg for one more.
Angled into middle, Pandya flicks but to mid-wicket.
Back of a length and on middle, this is pushed back towards the bowler.
On off, defended out.
Length ball, angled into the pads, Pant defends it out solidly.
FOUR! SMACKED! Short ball, outside off. Pant gets on his toes and cuts it through point for a fine boundary.
Nice way to get off the mark. It is full and on off. Hardik Pandya drives it through covers. The batters take three before the fielder cuts it out.

DRINKS! England have done well with the ball so far. Reece Topley dominated the first Powerplay and put his side well ahead in this chase. India have some depth with the bat and would hope their rest of the pack does the trick for them. There is still a long way to go but India don't have much wickets in hand. Hardik Pandya is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Craig Overton finds the breakthrough and sends back Yadav on just 16 runs. It is a length ball that lands outside off and nips in a touch. Suryakumar Yadav stays inside the crease and tries to block it away. It takes the outside edge and goes towards the keeper. Jos Buttler makes no mistake behind the sticks.
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Craig Overton

Commentary.Commentary: Short ball, around the hips. Pant pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Yadav flicks it to mid-wicket, not in the gap though.
Full, on off, blocked out.
On off, blocked back to the bowler.

BYE! Misses everyone! Rishabh Pant survives. It is looped up, outside off, turns away. Rishabh Pant dances down the track and tries to hit it down the ground but does not get anywhere near the ball. Jos Buttler misses to gather it, or else it could've been curtains for Pant. They collect a bye.
On middle, Yadav stays back and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
On leg, Pant flicks it to square leg for a single.
Length, on off. Yadav works it to mid on.
Good length, outside off, Pant works it to third man for one.
FOUR! Off the edge! Fraction short, outside off. Pant stays back and looks to heave it away down the ground. He mistimes it, as it flies off the outside edge over the keeper as well for a boundary.
Yadav guides this length delivery down to third man for one.
Length ball, outside off. Yadav gets behind and blocks it back to the bowler.
Length ball, angled into the pads, Rishabh Pant flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
Good length, outside off. Pant shuffles and tucks it to square leg for a single.
Flighted and full, on off. Pant blocks it back to the bowler.
A single now as this is worked down towards mid on.
On off, eases down to mid off.
Floated and full, outside off. Yadav drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
Tossed up, around off. Pant pushes it to cover with soft-hands and scampers across for a single.
Good length yet again, wide outside off. Yadav cuts it past point for two runs.
Good length, outside off. Yadav punches it to cover but not in the gap.
Length and on off, defended out.
Back of a length, outside off. Pant cuts it to deep point for a single. Exceptional effort in the deep by the fielder. It wasn't great running though, as Pant was ball-watching most of the time.
Length ball, on the pads, Pant tries to flick it away but misses. It goes off his gloves but lands in front of the keeper.
Short ball, on the pads. Yadav flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Touch short, outside off. Yadav cuts it late through backward point for a single.
Looped up, on off. Pant works it to long off for one.
A single now as this is worked through mid on.
Short and wide outside off. Pant stays back and slaps it to deep point for a single.
Full, on off, Yadav shuffles across and flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
Looped up, on the pads, Pant clips it through square leg for one.
Fuller, on leg, Pant clips it to deep square leg for a single. Just three runs off the over then.
On the pads, on a length, flicked to the leg side.
Short ball, outside off. Yadav pulls it through square leg with good control for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Pant pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
A length ball, on off. Pant gets an inside edge on the pads.
A short ball, angled across outside off. Pant stays back and chops it to point.
Powerplay 1 comes to an end. Now 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle until the end of the 40th over. Brydon Carse comes into the attack now.
Fuller, on off. Yadav tries to push it to the on side but it goes to cover off the outer half.
Another one on the fuller side, Yadav pushes it to mid off.
That is a good delivery! Length and on off, a little bit of shape back into the batter. Defended.
Another one on a length and around off, Yadav pushes it to covers.

A direct hit and Pant was gone! Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off. Pant goes for one. Stokes picks the ball up one-handed and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Had he hit, Pant was a goner. The dive would not have saved him.
On off, Pant pushes it to covers.
A dot to end then! Fuller and on middle, Yadav pushes it to mid off.
Not sure if that was there to be cut! Shorter and just outside off, not enough room on offer. Yadav slashes but is beaten. That was a little too full too.
Yadav misses out! This was there to be hit! Full and on the pads, it is flicked but to mid-wicket.
FOUR! This is a poor delivery, a gift for Kumar to get off the mark! Short and wide outside off, Yadav stands tall and cuts it through point for a boundary.
That is a beautiful stroke from Yadav to begin with! Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
Suryakumar Yadav is the new man in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Topley has taken England on top with the important wicket of Kohli! Yet again, Virat was looking so good but falls after getting off to a start. Topley has his third. A beauitful delivery this. It is on a length, it lands on off and moves away just a little. Kohli leans forward and looks to defend but this goes off the outside edge and it is taken by the wicket keeper. India slip further now.
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Reece Topley

Commentary.Commentary: Yet another one which is just outside off, Pant does not play at this one too.
Nice away swing, it is outside off. Pant leaves it.
Close! Kohli flicks it off middle pole this time, it goes more off the inner half down to fine leg for one.
Back of a length and on off, Kohli defends it towards point.
A slower one now outside off, Kohli leaves it alone.

FOUR! Uppish but wide of the fielder at mid-wicket. Kohli is shuffling across quite a bit. Willey is trying to ping the front pad. Kohli gets bat to ball and works it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
A dot to end! On a length and around off, Pant pushes it to covers.
Fuller and on middle, Kohli strokes it down the ground. The man at mid on, runs to his left, dives and keeps it down to one.
Back of a length and on middle, defended.
Outside off, Pant opens the face of the bat at the end and guides it through point for one.
Pant misses out! This is short and wide outside off, Pant cuts it hard but finds point.
Fuller and on middle, Rishabh plays it to mid on.
Pant gets off the mark! On middle, length, this is pushed to mid on for one.
Now takes one! Outside off, Kohli guides it down to third man for one.
Shorter and on off, Kohli hangs back and pushes it to covers.

FOUR! Kohli has began in the best possible way! He walks across, this is full and swinging into the pads. It is worked fine and into the fine leg fence. A little punch in the air after that got to the boundary from Kohli. He is pumped up here.
Another one on a length and around off, it is defended.
FOUR! Finds the gap! A little bit of width and that was enough! Shorter and around off, Kohli slaps it through covers and this one races away to the fence.
Rishabh Pant is the new man in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Rohit was gutted as soon as the catch was taken and rightly so. That was not a delivery he should have played. The left-armer's angle though, makes the batters play at deliveries one should be leaving. This starts around or just outside off. Slants away. Rohit plays a nothing shot. He pokes at it. The ball goes off the outside edge and it is taken by Root at widish first slip. Big wicket as Rohit was looking great. India in a spot of bother here.
Commentary.Howout: c Joe Root b Reece Topley

Commentary.Commentary: Well fielded again! Fuller and on off, Sharma times it past the bowler, Stokes at mid off dives to his right and makes a really good stop.
Solid! On a length and around off, defended towards the leg side.
Length and outside off, Sharma watches it go through to the keeper.
FOUR! Up and over! That was not that short but Rohit picks the length early, this is pulled over the mid-wicket fielder and into the fence behind. Welcome boundary as things did get a little quiet.
Quick run! Fuller and on off, Kohli looks to drive, it goes off the inner half towards mid off for one.
Another one on a length and around off, Sharma pushes it to mid off. A tidy over from Willey.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side, some swing but down the leg side. Rohit misses the flick. Wided.
Angled into the pads, Kohli works it down to fine leg and takes one. He gets off the mark after nine deliveries.
Length yet again and on off, Kohli pushes it to covers.
Another one on a length and on off, defended nicely.
On a length yet again, good tidy stuff, this is defended nicely.
A little too straight, this is clipped through square leg for one.
A wicket maiden then by Topley! Length and on off, defended.
Lovely drive but well fielded! Fuller and on off, Kohli strokes it to the right of Stokes who runs to that side and stops it well.
Good shot but for no runs! Back of a length and on off, Kohli stays back and guides it towards point.
Well bowled! Goes for the yorker and on middle, this is jammed out towards point.
Just outside off, on a length. Left alone.
Virat Kohli walks out at number 3 when the ball is still new.

OUT! TAKEN! Wicket number one goes down and it is yet again, that man, the one who recorded the best figures for England in an ODI in the last game, Reece Topley! Dhawan walks back for yet another low score. This is fuller and just outside off, Dhawan looks to drive but fails to keep it down. It goes to Roy at point who takes a low catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Roy b Reece Topley

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Timed beautifully again! Second boundary in the over and this is a wonderful start for India and Rohit! Shorter and on off, this is guided through point and this one races away to the fence.
Half an appeal but only from the men behind in the stumps! On the pads, Sharma looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Drags his length back now and lands it on off, defended.
FOUR! Creamed! That is beautiful! Fuller and outside off, Rohit shows the full face of the bat and strokes it through covers. This one races away to the fence. Consecutive boundaries for Rohit.
Dhawan is off the mark now! Fuller and around off, this one shapes away a touch. Dhawan opens the face of the bat and guides it past point for one.
Right on the money to begin with! Length and on off, Dhawan defends.
David Willey to steam in from the other end.
FOUR! Clipped away! Nicely played! Fuller and on middle, Sharma flicks it through mid-wicket and gets off the mark in style. Poor ball to end by Topley.
Short and this one skids through. Rohit is hurried onto the pull, it hits the splice and goes towards mid on.
On the pads, Rohit hops and works it to mid-wicket.
Solid from Rohit! Length and on off, Rohit defends it.
Now this one is outside off, trying to bring it back in. Yet again no movement. Left alone.
Goes full, looks for some swing but there is not a lot. Sharma strokes it to mid off.
